title: Side Pocket 2: Densetsu no Hustler
native_title: サイドポケット２ ～伝説のハスラー～
overview:
Surrender yourself to the jazzy sound and savor the feeling of being a hustler...

Side Pocket 2 is a pocket billiards game played on an overhead view of the table, with live-action scenes and a jazz soundtrack setting the mood. Aim with the guide line, which also shows bank shots off the rails, choose where the cue strikes the ball for draw, follow, spin or masse, then time the power meter to take your shot.

- Story Mode: take on a series of pool hustlers around the city, with live-action video between matches
- Tournament Mode: Eight Ball, Nine Ball, Rotation, 14.1 Continuous and One Pocket events, with trophies to collect
- Versus Mode: play the computer or a friend, in best-of matches or a betting game where the loser runs out of money
- Trick Game: sink every ball in one shot across a set of trick-shot layouts
- Training: practice freely on a full rack
- Progress saved to backup memory

JAZZYな響きに身をゆだね、ハスラー気分を満喫……。
